verdict.rationale: The only webhook evidence is a single mention that Quo fires a dedicated webhook on call-summary events, and that is gated to business and scale plans. Nothing documents webhooks for message events or core call events, or how a developer registers an endpoint. Missing for 10: webhooks for message events, webhooks for call lifecycle events (started, completed, missed), documented webhook registration and endpoint management, payload and signature docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, call and message events arrive as webhooks I can wire into my own systems

citations.quote: A dedicated webhook triggers on call-summary events.
